title: 2022 Score First Ballot #FB-JR Jerry Rice San Francisco 49ers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2022 Score First Ballot trading card featuring Jerry Rice of the San Francisco 49ers from the National Football League (NFL). The card is in standard size and is an original licensed reprint. It is a special insert card with card number FB-JR, showcasing Rice as a Hall of Famer. The card is in English and manufactured by SCORE in the United States for the 2022 football season.
